## How to print

1. **Prepare the document:** Export or save the document as a PDF.
2. **Send the print job:** Email the PDF to [mp@fs.de](mailto\:mp@fs.de) as an attachment.
3. **Important — Outlook on the web:** Attach the PDF as an actual file, not as a OneDrive link. If Outlook offers a choice, select **Attach as copy** rather than sharing a link. Before sending, verify that the PDF appears as a file attachment.
4. **Authenticate at the printer:** Go to the shared printer and place your employee card on the card reader.
5. **Print:** Select your submitted print job on the printer's display and initiate printing.

:::{.callout-warning title="Attach the PDF file"}
OneDrive sharing links are not suitable. The PDF must be included as a file attachment in the email.
:::
